response.justification: Bogdan is an accomplished full-stack/backend engineer with 15+ years of experience and strong low-latency systems work (DLang microservices at Sociomantic, C/C++ at National Instruments), but the role requires principal-level hardware architecture expertise that is entirely absent from the resume. There is no evidence of SoC or IP modeling, RTL/architectural simulation, GPU or accelerator architecture, SIMD/MIMD design, deep neural network training/inference optimization, or hardware-software co-design. His education is a BS in Computer Science (meeting the 8+ years experience path formally), but the domain mismatch is fundamental and not bridgeable through a screening interview for a principal IC hardware performance role.
strengths: 15+ years of engineering experience across web, mobile, and embedded
Low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of req/sec, async I/O, C/C++)
Strong open-source, tooling, and technical-community/teaching track record
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, GPU, or accelerator architecture experience
No deep-learning workload or inference/training optimization background
Career trajectory is web/product engineering, not hardware performance architecture

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture experience
No AI accelerator / deep-learning workload expertise
Deep general software experience with some low-level C/C++ and performance work
